text:
sqlpipe v2.0 delivers faster exports and more flexible pipelines.

Breaking change: the `/v2/users` response no longer includes the `name` field. It has been replaced by `first_name` and `last_name`. Update integrations, schemas, queries, and downstream mappings before upgrading. Consumers that still expect `name` will require migration.

A new `--incremental` flag lets pipelines process only newly available or changed data instead of rebuilding the full output. This reduces unnecessary work and makes recurring jobs more efficient.

Parquet writing is now 40% faster, significantly shortening export times for large datasets and improving throughput in data-intensive workflows.

Review your `/v2/users` consumers, update field mappings, and test existing pipelines before deploying sqlpipe v2.0 to production.
